title: Platform settings
description: Manage the public template, default theme, CAPTCHA, SEO and page cache in one place. Sensitive credentials remain injected through the restricted environment.
action.queue_purge: Queue all public pages for cache refresh
help.appearance: Choose the shared layout density and default light or dark theme. A visitor's explicit theme choice still takes precedence.
help.captcha: The behavioral challenge protects password sign-in for users and administrators. Password checks, rate limits and session protection remain active when it is disabled.
help.seo_cache: The indexing switch controls robots.txt, sitemap.xml, page robots metadata and public-page response headers.
help.save_scope: Settings apply to subsequent requests immediately. New CAPTCHA parameters begin with the next challenge.
help.cdn: Only configuration status is shown; Tencent Cloud secrets are never echoed. A separate worker performs the actual purge.
help.cdn_worker: Queuing does not contact Tencent Cloud. Run bin/purge-edgeone-cache.php from the scheduler.
help.extensions: This summary reports the actual state of built-in extensions and links to their dedicated management pages.
extension_detail.edgeone: Credentials are environment-only and purge jobs process allowlisted public pages.
extension_detail.oauth: The configuration entry is reserved; third-party sign-in is not open.
extension_detail.managed_elsewhere: This extension has its own management page and is not duplicated here.
message.error.permission_denied: This administrator cannot change platform settings.
message.error.session: Your session or request origin is no longer valid. Sign in again.
message.error.invalid: The platform settings are invalid. Review the values and try again.
message.error.captcha_targets: Choose 2 to 4 target clicks and keep the minimum no greater than the maximum.
message.error.captcha_ttl: The challenge lifetime must be between 60 and 600 seconds.
message.error.captcha_tolerance: The click tolerance must be between 8 and 24 pixels.
message.error.cache_ttl: The page cache lifetime must be between 0 and 3600 seconds.
message.error.service: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
message.error.generic: The operation did not complete. Check the values or sign in again.
